reads.name: scene.capture_view

camera.description: Look through this camera object instead of framing.

reads.name: scene.contact_sheet
reads.description: Frames through their cameras as one image: by default each timeline marker's frame through its bound camera, else the given frames through camera (or the scene camera). Viewport-shaded (material preview with the scene world) or rendered by engine at low samples. The current frame, active camera, render settings and the user's view are restored; an engine render replaces the Render Result.

frames.description: Frames to show (1 to 36); default: the timeline markers bound to cameras.

camera.description: Camera object for frames (default: the scene camera).

width.description: Width of each tile; the height follows the render aspect.

scene_world.description: Material preview with the scene world and lights.

engine.description: Render with this engine instead of the viewport (the default in the background is workbench).

samples.description: EEVEE or Cycles samples for engine renders.

One undo step; the file is marked modified.
operations.sideEffect: Downloads from Sketchfab; the import finishes in a task (blender_tasks).

operations.name: addons.search_blenderkit_assets
operations.description: Search BlenderKit assets using its public search API and local auth headers when available.

operations.name: addons.search_sketchfab_models
operations.description: Search Sketchfab's public API for downloadable models.

operations.name: animation.aim_bone
operations.description: Rotate a pose bone so one of its axes (Y: head to tail) points along a world direction, optionally keyed at a frame. Works from world matrices, whatever the bone axes, rotation mode and armature scale; returns the rotation written, its quaternion and the alignment (1 = exact). A bone with active constraints or locked rotation channels is refused before anything changes.

direction.description: World direction [x, y, z] to aim at (normalised).

frame.description: Pose at this frame and insert a rotation keyframe there; the current frame is restored.

operations.name: animation.attach_to_bone
operations.description: Make an object (a prop, a camera target) follow a bone with a Child Of constraint named OpenCode Attach, without the armature's scale by default: offset (metres) and rotation (radians, XYZ) are in the bone's axes from its head or tail, and the object keeps its size. With keep_world, it stays where it is and follows from there. Returns the world location and the residual error.

name.description: Object to attach (it must have no parent).

offset.description: Offset [x, y, z] in metres, in the bone's axes.

rotation.description: Rotation [x, y, z] in radians, in the bone's axes.

keep_world.description: Keep the object where it is.

operations.name: animation.create_turntable_animation
operations.description: Create a simple turntable rotation animation on an object.

operations.name: animation.edit_keyframes
operations.description: Delete, or move by offset frames, the existing keys between frame_start and frame_end of an object's keyed channels in Blender 5's layered actions (through the object's action slot): all channels, one data_path (and index), or those of one bone. Moving onto an existing key is refused. Returns the keys changed per channel.

name.description: Animated object (an armature for bone channels).

data_path.description: e.g. location, rotation_quaternion (relative to the bone when bone is set).

remove_empty.description: Remove a channel left without keys.

operations.name: animation.keyframe_object_transform
operations.description: Set transform values and insert keyframes on an object.

operations.name: animation.set_timeline_settings
operations.description: Set timeline range and playback FPS.

The task lists the created objects and collections with native references; the import is one undo step and marks the file modified.
operations.sideEffect: Imports a model; an https:// source is downloaded first.

source.description: A .glb, .gltf, .fbx, .obj or .usd/.usda/.usdc/.usdz file path, or an https:// URL (a .zip is unpacked).

format.description: Only when the extension does not tell.

operations.name: entity.create
operations.description: Native plan intent: create a collection, an object (existing data or none), a host bmesh primitive (object and mesh) or a node in a Geometry/Shader tree, from a recipe listed by describe. The exact name must be free; the creation is bound to a batch alias.

recipe.description: Recipe identifier from describe: collection, object, primitive:<NAME> or node:<NodeType>.

owner.description: Node recipes only: reference of the owner node tree.

data.description: Object recipe only: reference of existing object data; omit for an Empty.

bind.description: Batch alias; later intents of the same apply reference it as $alias.

operations.name: entity.rename
operations.description: Native plan intent: rename a collection, object, node, node group or scene; the reference keeps its identity and the name must be free.

operations.name: object.parent
operations.description: Native plan intent: parent an object to another object, or clear its parent with null, keeping its world transform at the current frame.

parent.description: Reference or $alias of the parent object, or null.

operations.name: property.set
operations.description: Native plan intent: set a property that describe marks writable, by its published RNA identifier; the value is validated against its type, shape, enum and bounds.

property.description: Published RNA identifier; never a path or a call.

value.description: JSON value of the property's type and shape.

operations.name: relation.link
operations.description: Native plan intent: add one collection edge (children or objects) that is absent; every other membership stays.

owner.description: Reference or $alias of the collection, including a scene root collection.

target.description: Reference or $alias of the child collection or object.

operations.name: relation.unlink
operations.description: Native plan intent: remove one existing collection edge; a move is link then unlink.

target.description: Reference or $alias of the child collection or object.

operations.name: render.render_animation
operations.description: Render the scene's animation in a separate background Blender, as a task to follow with blender_tasks (frames done and total, the frame and samples being rendered, seconds per frame, errors of the render log; cancel with blender_tasks cancel). It reads the file as saved on disk with the file's own render settings; resolution_percentage, samples and engine override them only when passed, in the render only. The task result states the settings used and the overrides. With unsaved changes it is refused (the saved file has older settings), unless unsaved is save (save first) or copy (render a working copy of the current state). Frames are PNG files in output (see output; the result names the folder and frame_files), whatever the file's own output settings; video encodes them as an H.264 MP4. The open document is not changed, and the render goes on if Blender is closed or OpenCode Link reloaded.
operations.sideEffect: Starts a separate Blender that writes PNG frames (and an MP4) to the output folder; the open document is not changed.

output.description: A folder for the frames (f_####.png), or a path ending in a frame pattern such as renders/shot_####: the folder is its directory and the # run is the frame number, zero-padded to its length. Default: renders/<file>-<time> beside the file. Refused if it already holds those frames.

unsaved.description: With unsaved changes: refuse, save the file first, or render a working copy of the current state.

resolution_percentage.description: 1 to 100; only when passed, in the render only (default: the file's).

samples.description: Cycles or EEVEE samples; only when passed, in the render only (default: the file's).

engine.description: Render engine; only when passed, in the render only (default: the file's).

scene.description: Scene to render (default: the active one).

operations.name: scene.create_object
operations.description: Create a primitive, camera, light, or empty in the active scene.

name.description: Optional explicit object name. Blender still applies collision suffixes when needed.

location.description: Optional world-space location as [x, y, z].

operations.name: scene.delete_object
operations.description: Delete one object by exact Blender name.

name.description: Exact Blender object name to remove.

operations.name: scene.duplicate_hierarchy
operations.description: Copy an object with all its children, as for a second character from a rigged import: object data copied (the armature too), parents, Armature modifiers and constraints that point inside the hierarchy rewired to the copies, actions copied (each copy animates on its own), linked (shared) or none (detached); moved by offset in metres. Returns the copies' names.

name.description: Root object (an armature or the import's top object).

offset.description: World offset [x, y, z] in metres for the copy.

collection.description: Collection for the copies (default: the originals' collections).

suffix.description: Appended to each copied name (default: Blender's .001 numbering).

operations.name: scene.place_on_ground
operations.description: Scale an object with its children about its origin to a height in metres, and put its lowest point at z = 0, measured on the evaluated geometry (armature deformation and modifiers included). Returns the factor, the move and the bounds before and after.

name.description: Object to scale and move (its children follow).

height.description: Target height in metres; omitted: no scaling.

ground.description: Put the lowest point at z = 0.

operations.name: scene.set_active_camera
operations.description: Set the active render camera for the current scene.

operations.name: scene.transform_object
operations.description: Update an object's location, rotation, and or scale. The rotation is given as Euler XYZ and written to the channel the object's rotation mode uses (converted to a quaternion, axis-angle or another Euler order); the result says which.

location.description: Optional world-space location as [x, y, z].

rotation.description: Optional Euler XYZ rotation in radians as [x, y, z], converted to the object's rotation mode.

scale.description: Optional scale factors as [x, y, z].

mapping_group_name.description: Optional shader node group used as the custom triplanar/randomizer mapping equivalent.

group_socket_map.description: Optional semantic-to-socket-name mapping override for the custom mapping group interface.

replace_existing.description: Whether to overwrite Blender materials that already exist with the same names.

use_fake_user.description: Whether converted materials should keep a fake user so they survive file cleanup.
